pr_body: This fix improves the symmetry drawing when symmetry and the pen pressure size are on.
pr_comments: First commit to fix https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/2584 (it works for symmetrical brushes, although the square brush is not working 🤔).

issue_context.title: Pen Pressure + Symmetry bug
issue_context.body:
Some pixels will either be removed or added when using vertical symmetry and pen pressure in tandem. In particular, pen pressure affecting pen size.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/75462439/101117510-58767900-35a4-11eb-8282-9a3270822cf2.png)


Aseprite v1.2.25-x64

Windows 10 Enterprise 10.0.18363
comments: This should be fixed in v1.2.26 https://community.aseprite.org/t/aseprite-v1-2-26/8720

review_comments: It looks like the brush center (brush->center()) is lost here, but I might be wrong. Maybe some tests could be created about this in https://github.com/aseprite/tests/blob/c4252301bf0272433d9c22d8922b536e963f602c/scripts/tools.lua#L391
I ran the tests and it was OK. To test a pen with dynamic size, we need first an emulation of pressure in app.useTool. I think, may be in a future.
